title: Check pinned archive file modes
summary: Compare Git file modes as well as blob contents so executable-bit drift cannot pass archival checks.
benefits: Preserves the full pinned Git record
risks: The check should use Git’s index so the result is not host filesystem dependent

evidence.claim: Before the v0.0.4 release: Draft PR #32 implements and exercises a mode-only archive drift regression.
v0.0.4 compares historical archive Git modes and blob contents with the pinned upstream trees and verifies the rebuilt Graphify maps.

decision.reason: Included in the owner-approved publication of Lydite v0.0.4. https://github.com/vixttha/Lydite-Test-Vault-Template/releases/tag/v0.0.4
